notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

[b]Key features of the demo include: [/b] 

[list] 

[*] Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  
[*] Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  
[*] Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 
[*] Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

[/list] 

[b]FAQ [/b] 

We also have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602000/discussions/0/596267508946698487/]frequently asked questions[/url] post in the discussion area on steam so you can get help if needed. This will be a work in progress, but please check there before posting as it’ll help manage the flow of questions incoming during the demo!   

[b]Content Creators playing Hotel Architect [/b] 

We also have a fantastic bunch of creators going live today and throughout Steam Next Fest, if you want to absorb more Hotel architect when you can't play yourself. Perhaps while working or travelling etc! Check out this list below:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/81fc235bcd2e99b627ed0c073d8b0a26713c6190.jpg[/img]  

Well Good Luck & get building!  

We can't for you to try it out, and let us know what you think!  

P.S. If you haven't already, there is also a giveaway happening for playing the demo! head to [url=Wired.gg/HAgiveaway]Wired.gg/HAgiveaway[/url] to be in with the chance of winning some epic Razer Tech worth of $350 and Hotel Architect goodies!

notes.title: Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Wooooooow![/h1]

April 21st just became the squishiest day EVER! Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles is OUT NOW on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, and Utomik!

A vibrant and poetic new launch trailer details Lumote’s epic adventure as it takes on a quest like never before to overthrow the mighty Mastermote. Introducing more of the world’s inhabitants found deep within The Great Depths, the lullaby-like trailer features all-new gameplay as Lumote solves the intricate puzzles found throughout its monumental journey. 

[previewyoutube=CiVOYFMKW-c;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you to everyone that has been with us on this long squishy journey, we hope that the new additions to Lumote in the Mastermote Chronicles will bring you as much joy as we had creating them - and don't forget, if you already own the original Lumote game on Steam, all of the new update content is free for you and will automatically update RIGHT NOW, featuring a whole new game world in which players take control of the Mastermote to tackle 15 new head scratching puzzles, new gold collectable artefacts to find and general bug fixes and graphical improvements.

For those of you that are venturing to the great depths for the first time - here's a quick run down of what to expect!

[h3]Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles Features[/h3]

[b]Seafoam Moocher [/b]: Squish, bop, and bounce through the world around you. Lumote is extremely curious, highly inquisitive, and adorable!

[b]That's one big world![/b] : The world of Lumote is a single massive environment with numerous puzzles separated into towers. Each tower marks your mastery of a specific Mote and unlocks a new set of puzzles to explore.

[b]Solve intricate puzzles[/b] : Set in a 3D puzzle adventure, clever and logical level design ease players in whilst increasing the complexity with each Mote you meet.

[b]Gorgeous sounds[/b] : A stunning score accompanies you, deep and trance-like that will take you on a majestical electronica soundscape journey.

[b]Luminated game engine[/b] : Using the original rEngine, Lumote’s puzzles are all interconnected, and you can seamlessly go from one puzzle to the next as you progress.

Additionally, to celebrate the launch we are running a competition where you can win a Nintendo Switch OLED and a copy of the game to play on it!

Entries for the competition run until May 9th - and you can enter by clicking RIGHT HERE! : [url=https://gleam.io/u7nOj/win-a-nintendo-switch-oled-and-copy-of-lumote]Nintendo Switch OLED Competition [/url]

The limited physical edition of the game, available on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4, contains a double-sided folded poster, reversible inlay, a unique set of stickers featuring the bioluminescent hero, plus a digital download for the Lumote EP, and, if that wasn’t enough, instructions to crochet your very own Lumote! The physical release is available on PlayStation 4 for €19.99 / $19.99 / £15.99 and Nintendo Switch for €29.99 / $29.99 / £24.99, and can be ordered now via the [url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/lumote-the-mastermote-chronicles]Wired Productions Store.[/url]

The Double Vinyl soundtrack for Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles is also available to pre-order now from the Wired Productions store for £35 / $45.

We hope you enjoy your time in the depths with Lumote - and once again, thank you for joining us on our luminescent journey - we can't wait to hear about your adventures!

If you want to share what you think with us - you can find us on the Official Lumote Discord available here : [url=https://discord.gg/8fKywBRYH5]Lumote Discord
[/url]

And we'd love to see your screenshots, photo mode creations, streams and art! Be sure to follow the Wired socials and share them with us!

notes.title: Lumote Mini Update! v1.1.3
notes.content:
Hi friends,

Some of you may have noticed a few patches pushed over the last few weeks. It's well overdue for us to tell you what has been done in that work!

[h2]SteelSeries Engine Integration[/h2]
We've partnered with [url=https://steelseries.com/engine/apps]SteelSeries[/url] to support their beautiful LED powered peripherals, [url=https://steelseries.com/engine/apps]check it out[/url]!

[previewyoutube=JLMqHftZ9eM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Linux (Proton) Support[/h2]
Shortly after releasing the demo, we were contacted by a Linux user who was having difficulty getting the game to start under Proton. Together we tracked down 2 bugs preventing Lumote from running.

Big thanks to [b]Sojiro84[/b] for the helping us track these down via [url=https://discord.gg/lumote]discord[/url]!
[list]
[*] We now include d3dcompiler_47.dll in our package - While all our shaders are shipped percompiled, we still use the shader compiler to generate some stubs at runtime so this is necessary for the game to run.
[*] Fixed thread mutex assert - Our engine's thread mutex wrapper was reading an uninitialized critical section structure. Turns out those structures are reset differently on Windows vs Proton when you destroy a critical section. This caused an exception under Proton which we never encountered on Windows!
[/list]
Going forward we will continue to provide bug fixes and support for Proton users. Please just reach out, we take pride in our software and we want to fix things!

[h2]General Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Resolved issue where users were getting the Don't Die achievement after finishing the game, even though they had died a lot.
[*] Fixed crash due to slow responses from Steam's achievements server. Part of developing and debugging games requires inserting special markers that cause the game to crash in known places so that we can spot potential issues. Generally, this stuff is disabled in a build released to the wild but it wasn't. So a number of non-critical checks were causing the game to crash. Sorry about that, it's fixed now :)
[/list]

Thanks!

/ Team Lumote

notes.title: New Languages, a Demo and a Soundtrack!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We hope you are all safe and healthy in these unprecedented times! We want to first throw out a [i]very big and long overdue [b]THANKS[/b][/i] to all the PAX East attendees that came by and said hi. It was great talking with everyone, and so much fun seeing people taking pictures with our pile of crochet Lumotes!

Due to the fact that we've been required to stay in side as much as possible since the release of Lumote on Steam in February, we have been hard at work in a few new things!
 
[h2]Patch v1.1.0[/h2] [list]
[*]  Added a puzzle name so everyone can refer to the puzzles by 1-1, 1-2, 2-1 and so on rather than just 10%, 15%, 30%, etc
[*] Fixed the time recording issue which caused speed runs to be slightly inaccurate according to the puzzle stats
[*] Fixed a handful of bugs that have been popping up related to puzzle exploits. Certain puzzles at the beginning of the game were very easy to circumvent which was causing confusion later in the game as players didn't learn the right things. We have made a few small tweaks to eliminated these shortcuts. - Sorry speed runners you'll need to find new routes!
[*]  The game should no longer crash if you have your Steam library in a location that contains a non-Latin symbol which seemed to be quite common for our Russian players
[/list]

[h3]SPEEDRUNNERS[/h3]
We want to support you and make Lumote the best speed run experience we can. Please stop by [url=https://discord.gg/lumote]our discord[/url] and share your thoughts!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/791240/Lumote/][h2]We've released a Demo for Lumote![/h2][/url] If you've been on the fence about picking up Lumote. Now's your opportunity to give it a try again! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/791240/Lumote/]Check it out and tell your friends![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179380/Lumote___Original_Soundtrack_by_Paul_Ruskay/][h2]The Soundtrack is finally available![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33381470/f58ca8af8007375372e59452ebb21861b6cef34b.png[/img]
[/url]
We've finally released the highly requested and long overdue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179380/Lumote___Original_Soundtrack_by_Paul_Ruskay/]Lumote - Original Soundtrack by Paul Ruskay[/url]. We had intended to release this along with the launch of the game, but circumstances prevented that from happening. With that in mind, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12374/Lumote__Game__Soundtrack/]Soundtrack + Game Bundle[/url] is available to all existing Lumote owners. That means that even if you already bought Lumote, the bundle discount to add on the soundtrack will be available to you, not just for new purchases. Now you can sip on the sweet ambient sound of Lumote anywhere you go!

[h2]Lumote Now Speaks 17 Languages![/h2]

While Lumote doesn't have a lot of text, the English only menus are still a barrier for some. To improve our usability world wide we have added support to the menus and Achievements for 16 new languages. - Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Czech, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese, Russian, Latin-American Spanish, Spanish, Thai, Ukrainian.
Thanks everyone, stay happy and healthy!

tags.bug: [*] Fixed the time recording issue which caused speed runs to be slightly inaccurate according to the puzzle stats

[*] Fixed a handful of bugs that have been popping up related to puzzle exploits. Certain puzzles at the beginning of the game were very easy to circumvent which was causing confusion later in the game as players didn't learn the right things. We have made a few small tweaks to eliminated these shortcuts. - Sorry speed runners you'll need to find new routes!
[*]  The game should no longer crash if you have your Steam library in a location that contains a non-Latin symbol which seemed to be quite common for our Russian players
